name: bespok3d-jinni-snapmaker-u1
title: Snapmaker U1 jinni
description: The Snapmaker U1's jinni: the printer-side process that reads this device's board, service and module facts and actuates the daemon's install operations on it. Bundles the shared klipper jinni runtime it extends, so a printer needs only this one package. It is not independently startable: the daemon owns its lifecycle and picks up a new jinni on the restart its own install op already performs.
tagline: The printer-side process that gives the daemon Snapmaker U1 device knowledge.
